_note: V2.8's verbs, on the effects.energy channel -- the ninth. Seven actions: six orders and one decommission. THE REGION IS NOT HERE and cannot be: it is the player's, named at execute time (V2.6b2's rule). The authored bloc_offset is the act's own national politics -- what the country thinks of building a reactor at all -- and it is SEPARATE from the local opposition Energy.opposition_points() charges for where it goes, which is the whole reason the click has a price of its own.
_decommission_note: ONE decommission for six sources, where data/project-actions/ authors a start and an abandon per project. A project is built once and its id IS the register key; a nation may hold four gas stations, so the target is a plant id chosen at execute time and there is nothing per-source to author. The off switch matters: a run cost with no way to stop it is V1.3g's permanent monotone charge, and the player must be able to close it.

actions.name: Order a reactor
actions.summary: Ten years and a fifth of a point of GDP a month, and the country stops buying gas.

actions.name: Order a gas station
actions.summary: Quick, cheap and burns something bought abroad.

actions.name: Order a coal station
actions.summary: Cheap power, domestic jobs, and the dirtiest thing on the list.

actions.name: Order a wind farm
actions.summary: Eighteen months, no fuel bill, and every hill has a committee.

actions.name: Order a solar park
actions.summary: The fastest thing on the list and the smallest.

actions.name: Order a hydro scheme
actions.summary: Six years, a valley, and power for a century.

actions.name: Close a station
actions.summary: Stop paying to run it. Whatever it was making, the country now buys.
